critic_issues.problem: The four lines assume different sides. [0] "{vehicle} destroyed in {zone}." is neutral. [1] "{vehicle} is burning. Crew status unknown." reads as a friendly loss. [2] "Hit confirmed: enemy {vehicle} knocked out." and [3] "{vehicle} destroyed. {count} enemy vehicles remain." can only be an enemy kill. The event has one key and no side placeholder, so a line can fire for the wrong side. A player vehicle loss could log "enemy {vehicle} knocked out", which is false.
critic_issues.fix: Make every vehicle_destroyed line side-neutral, or use {enemy} for enemy kills and {vehicle} for friendly losses and keep them in separate lines. Remove "enemy" from [2] and "enemy vehicles remain" from [3], or confirm the event only fires for enemy vehicles and reword [1] to match.

critic_issues.problem: Hold/cover filler repeats in the same phase. Bombardment[0] "Stay in cover and ride it out.", [1] "Hold position." and [2] "Hold." all say the same thing. Intel[1] "Stay in cover. Stay concealed." also repeats briefing line 4 almost word for word.
critic_issues.fix: Give each line one distinct piece of information. For example, in Bombardment, say which positions are revealed or when the shelling should lift. In Intel, give the enemy composition or direction instead of repeating the cover advice.

critic_issues.problem: "Do not let them reach the deployment zone." repeats briefing.lines[3] and adds no new information in the last phase.
critic_issues.gdd: Defeat the moment an enemy unit breaks through into the player's deployment zone
critic_issues.fix: Replace it with a phase-specific cue, such as infantry now on foot inside rifle range, or drop the line.

critic_issues.problem: "Revealed units: break line of sight or hold in cover." reads like an instruction the player can give. The player has only Forward, Hold, Back and Retreat. Breaking line of sight is done by the squad AI inside its order.
critic_issues.gdd: Units never abandon their order, but they fight intelligently inside it: ... breaking line of sight when outmatched
critic_issues.fix: Reword it as a status line, e.g. "Revealed units are being tracked. Hold or fall back.", or drop the line.

critic_issues.problem: "Enemy {enemy} observed in {zone}." and "enemy {vehicle}" put the word "enemy" next to a placeholder that may already carry it (e.g. "Enemy enemy BMP"). "observed" is also the only line in its set that omits {distance}.
critic_issues.fix: Drop the literal "Enemy" before {enemy}, and use "{enemy} observed in {zone}, {distance} m."

briefing.title: Assault on the Line
lines: Company commander, listen up. Enemy assault expected on our sector within minutes.
Armour leads, then transports with mechanised infantry. Expect drones and artillery first.
Your orders: Forward, Hold, Back, Retreat. Use drones on armour, rifles on infantry.
Stay in cover and stay concealed. Do not let one enemy unit into the deployment zone.

Intel: HQ to all units: enemy column massing beyond the ridge. Assault is coming.
Stay in cover. Stay concealed. Hold your positions and wait.
Expect armour first, then transports with infantry behind it.
Scouting: Enemy scout drones over the line. Keep your heads down.
Revealed units: break line of sight or hold in cover.
Scout drones reveal at 150 metres. Do not move in the open.
Bombardment: Artillery on revealed positions. Stay in cover and ride it out.
Do not break cover during the barrage. Hold position.
Recon reports guns are firing from beyond our range. Hold.
VehicleAdvance: Armour on the road, closing fast. Save drones and anti-tank for the vehicles.
Rifles will not stop armour. Use anti-tank teams and drones.
Light armour is exposed to heavy machine guns. Hold the line.
Anti-tank teams hold fire until vehicles are in range.
MechanizedInfantry: Transports behind the armour. They will stop and unload 300 to 600 metres out.
Drones can still reach them before they dismount. Strike the transports.
Infantry dismounting, coming on foot. Hold the line with rifles.
Do not let them reach the deployment zone.

squad_lost: {squad} is down. No contact on the net.
artillery_incoming: Impact in seconds at {zone}. Heads down.
transport_unloading: Transport stopped at {distance} m. Infantry unloading.
Troops on foot at {distance} m. Prepare to receive.

output.routing_message: The enemy is routing — victory is near.

critic_issues.problem: "Enemy infantry now inside rifle range of the forward squads." is a fixed line that asserts a battlefield state. Unloading happens at 300–600 m and small arms reach 180 m, so the line can be false when it plays.
critic_issues.gdd: Transports ... stop and unload at **300–600 m** from the player's line (outside small-arms range; drones can still reach them), and the infantry continues on foot
critic_issues.fix: Reword it as an expectation, e.g. "Infantry will close to rifle range on foot. Hold the line."

critic_issues.problem: "Expect the main axis along the road toward our centre." names a road and a sector layout the GDD doesn't define, so it may not match the FlatTest map.
critic_issues.fix: Drop it or replace it with a line grounded in the phase, e.g. "Enemy drones will come first. Stay concealed."

critic_issues.problem: "Company commander, listen up." is casual. The brief asks for terse, serious radio voice.
critic_issues.gdd: The tone is grounded and serious.
critic_issues.fix: Use "Company commander, brief follows. Enemy assault expected on our sector."

critic_issues.problem: "Close the gap." reads as an instruction the player cannot give. The player has only four orders and no order to reposition or fill a gap.
critic_issues.gdd: The player has four orders only (Forward, Hold, Back, Retreat)

critic_issues.problem: "{unit} drone hit {enemy} at {distance} m." is awkward with the {unit} placeholder. It is also the only drone_hit line that gives a distance, which a strike on a target may not have.
